title: Which MySQL or SQL Server edition fits you?

questions.q: What is your budget for licences?
questions.hint: Software cost is only part of the bill. Hosting and staff time count too.

options.label: I can pay for a paid edition
options.why: you can pay for a paid edition

options.label: Budget is not the main worry
options.why: cost is not your main limit

questions.q: How big will one database get?

options.label: Over 50 GB
options.why: SQL Server Express stops at 50 GB per database

questions.q: What does your team already use?

options.label: Microsoft tools
options.why: your team and tools are Microsoft-centred

options.label: Open source, or no strong habit
options.why: you want open source or have no Microsoft ties

questions.q: How much failover do you need?

options.label: Always On availability groups
options.why: Always On availability groups are Enterprise only in SQL Server 2025

options.label: A production app
options.why: Developer editions are licensed for development and test, not production

options.label: Only development and testing
options.why: you only need dev and test

mysql-community.name: MySQL Community Edition
mysql-community.summary: Free under the GPL version 2, with no free tier limit listed.
mysql-community.bestWhen: Cost and open source matter, or your hosting already assumes MySQL.
mysql-community.watchOut: The thread pool is Enterprise only, and we could not read Oracle's full feature table.

mysql-paid.name: MySQL Standard or Enterprise
mysql-paid.summary: Oracle subscriptions listed from $2,140 and $5,350 for a 1 to 4 socket server (checked Oct 2026).
mysql-paid.bestWhen: You like MySQL and want to move from Community to a paid plan later without changing databases.
mysql-paid.watchOut: Oracle's store shows price ranges without saying what they mean, so check it before you budget.

sql-standard.name: SQL Server 2025 Standard
sql-standard.summary: Listed at $3,945 per 2-core pack, capped at 32 cores and 256 GB of buffer pool memory (checked Oct 2026).
sql-standard.bestWhen: Your team lives in the Microsoft world and basic failover is enough.
sql-standard.watchOut: Only basic availability groups, with two replicas and one database.

sql-enterprise.name: SQL Server 2025 Enterprise
sql-enterprise.summary: Listed at $15,123 per 2-core pack, limited only by the operating system (checked Oct 2026).
sql-enterprise.bestWhen: You need Always On availability groups with up to 8 secondary replicas.
sql-enterprise.watchOut: The highest list price here, and a reseller may quote you something different.

sql-express.name: SQL Server Express
sql-express.summary: Free, with 50 GB per database, up from 10 GB in SQL Server 2022.
sql-express.bestWhen: A small app fits inside the free limits and you want Microsoft tooling.
sql-express.watchOut: Capped at 4 cores, 1,410 MB of buffer pool memory and 50 GB per database, with no SQL Server Agent.

sql-developer.name: SQL Server Developer
sql-developer.summary: Free, with features that match production, for development and test.
sql-developer.bestWhen: You want to test production features without paying.
